verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing is a fair question for any software product, including a hosted research assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Gemini Notebook's source code published under an open license. Public notebook sharing is an adjacent feature, and the community mention of reading source code concerns other projects the user uploaded, not this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
